verdict.rationale: Next.js is an open-source React framework, not a hosted service that holds a user's account data. Exporting all of one's data from the product does not fit this kind of product. The self-hosting and static-export docs and the community lock-in comments are about deployment portability, a different story, so they are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
